Broomfield Voter Guide: Key Dates, Where to Vote and What's on the Ballot

The 2026 election in Broomfield was held Tuesday, November 3, 2026. It is over.

Link copied!

The election is over. This page stays up for reference.

Key dates

DateWhat happens
Friday, October 2 Passed Ballots mailed to residents Allow 7 days to receive. Source: broomfield.org
Monday, October 19 Passed Voter Service and Polling Center opens Residents may vote in person October 19 through November 3. Source: broomfield.org
Monday, October 26 Passed Last recommended day to mail your voted ballot Source: broomfield.org
Tuesday, November 3 Passed Election Day Ballots must reach the Elections Division by 7 p.m. The city recommends hand-delivering your ballot rather than mailing it. Source: broomfield.org

Register and return your ballot

You can register to vote or update your registration at any Voter Service and Polling Center.

Ballots were mailed starting October 2. Return yours by mail (the last recommended day to mail is October 26), at a 24-hour drop box, or at a Voter Service and Polling Center. Track your ballot (Colorado Secretary of State).

Where to vote

These Voter Service and Polling Centers offer ballot drop-off, in-person voting, replacement ballots, and new or updated voter registration.

Voting locations

  • George Di Ciero City and County Building
    One DesCombes Dr.
    • Oct. 19 to Nov. 2: Mon.–Fri., 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
    • Sat., Oct. 31: 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
    • Sun., Nov. 1: Closed
    • Election Day, Nov. 3: 7:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m.
  • Flatiron Marketplace
    170 E. Flatiron Crossing Dr.
    • Fri., Oct. 30, and Sat., Oct. 31: 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
    • Sun., Nov. 1: Closed
    • Mon., Nov. 2: 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
    • Election Day, Nov. 3: 7:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m.
  • Paul Derda Recreation Center
    13201 Lowell Blvd.
    • Mon., Nov. 2: 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
    • Election Day, Nov. 3: 7:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m.
  • Broomfield Municipal Shops
    3951 W. 144th Ave.
    • Mon., Nov. 2: 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
    • Election Day, Nov. 3: 7:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m.

What's on the ballot

  • 1A - Broomfield Lodging Tax
  • 1B - Xcel Franchise Agreement
  • 1C - Future Mayor Term and Term Limits
  • 7E - Term Limits for the 17th Judicial District Attorney

These are the Broomfield-specific ballot questions the city lists. Your full ballot, including candidate races and statewide contests, is on the sample ballot.
